newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ometraco Corp secures $125 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Ometraco Corp secures $125 mln loan.

text.p: Indonesia's conglomerate PT Ometraco Corporation and unlisted unit Ometraco Multi Artha said on Tuesday they had jointly obtained a $125 million syndicated loan to repay debt, expand business and strengthen working capital.
The syndicated revolving credit facility, which matures in December 1998, was oversubscribed 30 percent, it said in a statement.
"The proceeds of the facility will be used jointly by Ometraco Corporation and Ometraco Multi Artha," it said.
The facility's arrangers were mostly Singapore-based branches of U.S., European and Japanese banks, it said.
Lead managers were Singapore branch of the Royal Bank of Canada and Singapore's Tat Lee Bank, it said.
Ometraco is one of Indonesia's largest conglomerates with interests in consumer foods, pharmaceuticals, infrastructure and financial services.
Ometraco's listed subsidiaries include integrated animal feed producer PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia, Bank Tiara, and power equipment manufacturer Trafindo Perkasa.
The statement did not give further details. Company officials were not immediately available for details.
